# CodeYourLogic

> Full company knowledge for AI agents. Index: https://codeyourlogic.com/llms.txt. Source of truth: https://codeyourlogic.com/about/.

## Company

CodeYourLogic is a custom software development company and technology partner. We engineer web applications, mobile apps, desktop software, WooCommerce stores, cloud and DevOps platforms, AI and machine-learning products, blockchain systems, and custom CRM and ERP platforms.

We work with startups, growing businesses, and enterprises that need custom software or dedicated engineering capacity — worldwide, with headquarters in Adityapur, India.

Enterprise software engineering with transparent delivery: full product teams or dedicated developers.

Legal name: CodeYourLogic Pvt Ltd. CodeYourLogic® is a registered trademark of CodeYourLogic Pvt Ltd.

### Cloud & DevOps
https://codeyourlogic.com/services/cloud-devops/

Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and automation that keep your products secure, scalable, and continuously deployable.

Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, and Azure with reliable CI/CD, containers and cost control.

What this service includes:
- Cloud Migration: Zero-downtime, secure legacy server migrations to state-of-the-art managed cloud architectures.
- Infrastructure as Code: Declare and provision your global cloud setups predictably with fully structured, reusable programmatic configurations.
- CI/CD Pipeline Setup: Automate building, testing, and shipping cycles to deployment pipelines with total transparency.
- Container Orchestration: Package and govern multiple elastic execution nodes dynamically for streamlined runtime scale.
- Serverless Architecture: Optimize cost boundaries using highly dynamic computing runtimes that scale effortlessly on demand.
- Monitoring & Observability: Set up extensive logs, real-time alerts, and deep dashboard visibility to address issues before they arise.
- Disaster Recovery: Robust, automated regular snapshots and geographically separated recovery loops to secure operational continuity.
- Cost Optimization: Eliminate wasteful computing allocations with data-driven system scaling and clean usage budgets.

Questions:
Q: Which clouds do you support?
A: AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure—plus multi-cloud and hybrid setups when needed.
Q: Do you set up CI/CD and Kubernetes?
A: Yes. We implement pipelines, container orchestration, monitoring and secure GitOps workflows.
Q: Can you reduce cloud spend?
A: Our FinOps practices typically cut waste with right-sizing, reserved capacity and observability.

Related industries: Logistics & Supply Chain, Finance & Banking, Manufacturing & IoT, Telecom & Networking, Government & Public

Representative technologies (not an exclusive catalog):
  - Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean

What this service includes:

- Sales and Pipeline: Leads, deals, quotes, and activity tracking your team will use every day.
- Inventory and Procurement: Stock, purchase orders, and suppliers kept in sync with sales and fulfillment.
- Finance and Billing: Invoices, payments, and accounting workflows tied to real orders and deliveries.
- Teams and Approvals: Roles, permissions, and approval steps that match how your company is organized.
- Integrations: Connect email, payments, WhatsApp, accounting tools, and the systems you already run.
- Reporting and Dashboards: Live views of pipeline, stock, revenue, and operations for the people who need them.

Questions:

A: We build custom CRM and ERP software, and we can also integrate or extend tools you already use when that is the better fit.
Q: Can CRM and ERP live in one system?
A: Yes. We design them as connected modules so a sale can update inventory, billing, and reporting without duplicate entry.
Q: Can you move our data from spreadsheets or an older system?
A: Yes. We plan the migration, map fields, and check records before your team switches over.

## Delivery process

The company-wide cycle from discovery through maintenance. Individual services adapt these stages to the product — they are not a second, conflicting process.

1. Discovery — We analyze business goals, audience, and constraints, then define roadmap, stack, and MVP scope so every feature maps to real value.
2. Design — UI/UX and interactive prototypes are validated before heavy build, reducing risk and aligning the product with users.
3. Development — Senior engineers build in agile sprints with weekly demos, visible boards, and a dedicated project manager.
4. QA — Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, plus structured manual QA, run before code ships to production.
5. Deployment — Release includes security review, environment setup, and production rollout — not a hand-off after the last commit.
6. Scaling — After launch we monitor performance, conversion, and infrastructure so the system grows with usage.
7. Maintenance — Ongoing support, runbooks, and knowledge transfer keep the product maintainable after the initial build.

Details: https://codeyourlogic.com/about/#delivery-process

## Engineering practices

- Architecture: We design for maintainability and scale from day one, with architecture documentation so your team can own the system.
- Testing: Engineers write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests before code ships. Service work also includes device and release QA where relevant.
- Peer review: Every line of code goes through mandatory peer review before production — stated in our quality practices on this site.
- Security: Security is treated as a delivery standard: reviews, encryption in transit and at rest where described, and OWASP-oriented web hardening on relevant work.
- CI/CD: Continuous integration and automated delivery pipelines are part of cloud/DevOps work and of how product teams ship.
- Agile development: We run agile sprints with weekly demos, daily standups on many engagements, and structured retrospectives.
- DevOps: Infrastructure, monitoring, and deployment automation sit alongside application engineering so launch and operations are one team.

Details: https://codeyourlogic.com/about/#engineering-practices

- Mobile Developers (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin): Ship polished iOS and Android apps with native feel, solid architecture, and smooth releases.
- Full Stack Developers (MERN, MEAN, React, Node.js): End-to-end engineers who own features across UI, APIs, data, and deployment with speed.
- DevOps Engineers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform): Automate delivery pipelines, harden cloud infrastructure, and keep systems reliable 24/7.
- AI/ML Engineers (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenAI, LangChain): Design and ship intelligent features — models, pipelines, and production ML systems.
- UI/UX Designers (Figma, Adobe XD): Turn product goals into clear flows, beautiful interfaces, and conversion-focused experiences.
- QA Engineers (Selenium, Appium): Protect quality with automated and manual testing so every release ships with confidence.

Engagement model:
- Full-time dedicated: Engineers embedded in your rituals, tools, and timezone overlap as an extension of your team.
- Part-time: A defined weekly capacity when you need specialist skills without a full-time seat.
- Project-based: Scoped delivery with dedicated resources for a product slice, migration, or launch window.

## Glossary

- CodeYourLogic / CodeYourLogic®: The brand name of the software engineering company. CodeYourLogic® is a registered trademark of CodeYourLogic Pvt Ltd.
- CodeYourLogic Pvt Ltd: The registered legal entity behind the website, contracts, and contact details.
- Hire Resources / dedicated developers: Staff-augmentation offering: vetted engineers, designers, and QA specialists who embed in the client’s workflow rather than only a fixed-scope product engagement.
- Technologies (page): The Technologies page describes how CodeYourLogic chooses a stack for a product. It is advisory and stack-agnostic — not a complete list of every tool the company can use.
- Delivery process: The company-wide path from discovery through maintenance. Homepage cards (Discover, Design, Build, Scale) summarize this cycle; service pages adapt the same stages.
- Enterprise software engineering: Positioning used on this site for custom product engineering with transparent delivery, quality practices, and either full teams or dedicated developers.

## Company FAQ

Q: What does CodeYourLogic do?
A: CodeYourLogic (CodeYourLogic Pvt Ltd) is a custom software development company and technology partner. We build web, mobile, desktop, WooCommerce, cloud/DevOps, AI, blockchain, and custom CRM and ERP software, and we provide dedicated engineering resources.

Q: What services does CodeYourLogic provide?
A: Major services are Web Development, Mobile Development, WooCommerce & E-commerce, Desktop Application Development, Cloud & DevOps, AI & Machine Learning, Blockchain, Custom CRM and ERP, and Dedicated Developers / engineering resources.

Q: Does CodeYourLogic build custom CRM and ERP systems?
A: Yes. Custom CRM and ERP covers sales pipelines, operations, inventory, finance, roles, integrations, and reporting. The system can be software your company owns, or it can connect to tools you already use.

Q: What technologies does CodeYourLogic use?
A: We choose stacks for the product. Representative tools already listed on this site include React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, AWS, Azure, GCP, TensorFlow, OpenAI, LangChain, Solidity, WordPress, and WooCommerce. Listed technologies are examples, not a closed catalog.

Q: Does CodeYourLogic build custom software?
A: Yes. Custom software — including SaaS platforms, portals, mobile apps, desktop tools, and integrations — is the core of the company offering.

Q: Does CodeYourLogic provide dedicated developers?
A: Yes. On Hire Resources you can engage frontend, backend, fullstack, mobile, DevOps, AI/ML, UI/UX, and QA specialists who join your workflow. Engagement is described as full-time, part-time, or project-based.

Q: Does CodeYourLogic work with startups and enterprises?
A: Yes. Site copy addresses startups, scaling companies, and enterprises that need custom software or dedicated teams.

Q: Which industries does CodeYourLogic serve?
A: Published verticals include restaurants & food, e-commerce, healthcare, real estate, finance, education, travel, logistics, media, automotive, agriculture, legal, insurance, manufacturing, government, and telecom. Related services are listed on the Industries page.

Q: Does CodeYourLogic provide AI/LLM development?
A: Yes. The AI & Machine Learning service covers custom models, chatbots, LLM integrations (including OpenAI and similar tools named on that page), RAG-style assistants, computer vision, NLP, and production MLOps practices described there.

Q: Does CodeYourLogic provide cloud and DevOps services?
A: Yes. Cloud & DevOps covers cloud architecture, migration, CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and related operations work on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and other platforms listed on that page.

Q: How does the development process work?
A: The company cycle is Discovery → Design → Development → QA → Deployment → Scaling → Maintenance. Home and service pages show condensed or service-specific views of the same cycle.
